disclaimerLine: This is not medical or dietitian advice.
refuseLeak: That is outside what I can help with. Ask about food, nutrition, weight, water, or fasting.

safe.injury: If you have a sharp or lasting injury or pain, stop and do not push through exercise. See a doctor or physiotherapist before you continue. I cannot plan meals or training around an injury, so wait for their guidance first.
safe.medical: Symptoms such as chest pain, shortness of breath, severe dizziness, fainting, or unusual blood sugar need a doctor, not a guess from an app. See a doctor or a dietitian. If it is severe or sudden, go to the emergency room or call emergency services. For medication and doses, ask a doctor or pharmacist.
safe.eatingDisorder: Thank you for telling me. I will not give advice on restricting food or cutting kcal. Eating patterns like this are best talked through with a doctor, a psychologist, or an adult you trust. You are not alone, and help is available.
safe.minorDiet: Under 18, I do not give diet advice, kcal counts for losing weight, or tips on eating less. A growing body needs enough food. If you are worried about your weight, talk to a parent, a doctor, or a dietitian.

errors.badKey: The provider rejected the key. Check that it was copied in full with no spaces, or create a new key in the provider account.
errors.forbidden: The provider denied access. This account or key may not use that model yet (permission, region, or inactive account). Check the provider account.
errors.quota: Quota or balance has run out. Top up or raise the spending limit in the provider account, then try again.
errors.rateLimit: Requests are limited for now. Wait a moment, then send again.
errors.modelNotFound: This model was not found. It may have been retired or your account may not have access. Pick another model.
errors.noTools: This model does not support reading extra data. Pick another model.
errors.badRequest: This request could not be processed. Try a shorter question, or pick another model.
errors.server: The server is having problems. Try again in a little while.
errors.network: Not connected. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.timeout: The answer took too long. Try again, or pick a faster model.
errors.empty: The model did not send a usable answer. Send again, or rephrase the question.
errors.truncated: The model kept thinking and ran out of room before writing an answer. Send again, or pick a faster model or one without a thinking mode.

blocked.minor: Joyo AI is not available under 18.
blocked.noProvider: No provider is set up, so nothing was sent. Set up your own key first.
blocked.badUrl: The server address cannot be used, so nothing was sent. Fix the address in the key settings.
blocked.noKey: The key is not on this phone, so nothing was sent. Enter the key again.
blocked.noConsent: Permission to share data is missing, so nothing was sent. Agree to it first.
blocked.ceiling: Today's call limit has been reached, so nothing was sent. Raise the limit in Joyo AI settings, or try again tomorrow.
blocked.notPro: Joyo AI on JoyoRogo needs JoyoRogo Pro. In the phone app you can use your own key for free.
blocked.cap: Today's Joyo AI question limit has been reached. Try again tomorrow.
blocked.off: Joyo AI is unavailable right now. Try again later.
blocked.notSignedIn: Sign in to JoyoRogo to use Joyo AI.
